summary: Validated new /api/apuracao/{cnpj}/{ano} endpoint and the new pgmei4.html apuração screen end-to-end. Backend returns 12 Liquidado periods with '-' values and business-day DAS vencimentos (feriado 20/11 observado). Full UI flow login -> pgmei2 -> pgmei3 (ano 2026) -> Ok -> pgmei4 works, overlay runs ~2s with no flash of CNPJ/Nome or dropdown-menu. Table has exactly 12 tr.pa rows, first Janeiro/2026, last Dezembro/2026, all show Liquidado and '-'. #selecionarTodos toggles 12 checkboxes; btnEmitirDas shows red banner when nothing selected and 'indisponibilidade' banner after ~2s with selected PA. Changing the year combo to 2024 and clicking Ok reloads with Janeiro/2024 as first row. Header shows '37.411.286/0001-08' and 'LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215' without flashes. #dataPagamentoInformada is prefilled dd/mm/aaaa.
critical_code_review_comments: pgmei4 inline script could be moved to pgmei-shared.js to reduce duplication across the 4 screens, but not critical.

_vencimento_das only treats weekends and 20/11 as non-business days; other national feriados (ex: Carnaval, Corpus Christi, 25/12 que caia em dia útil fora dos jogos) ainda não são considerados, mas suficiente para o fluxo de estudo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 features in request passed: GET /api/apuracao for 2026 and 2024 CNPJs match expected vencimentos; pgmei4.html full flow (login, year select, Ok, overlay, table, selecionarTodos, btnEmitirDas banners, year change) all operational. Checkbox data-testid='pa-check-YYYYMM' present. No flash of nav dropdown-menu or '--/Carregando...' observed during 20x100ms polling after Ok.
